text: なんじゃー　つかまえかたを　しらんのか！

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた added to a verb stem means 'the way of doing it'. つかまえかた = 'how to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is an old-man or rough form of ない, 'not'. しらん = 'don't know'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end asks a question with surprise, wanting the fact confirmed. しらんのか = 'you mean you don't know?'.
